title: Choosing the Number of Attention Heads from Intrinsic Dimension: A Small-Scale Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.19966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The number of attention heads in a transformer is usually set by convention or grid search. We test a simple heuristic for setting it in advance: estimate the intrinsic dimension of token representations without labels, and use roughly that many heads. We estimate intrinsic dimension with a nested-dropout VAE trained on DistilBERT embeddings of WikiText-2, choosing the KL weight at the knee of the VAE's rate-distortion curve rather than by hand. This gives $k^*=9.2$ (95% CI [8.6, 9.8]). In a small 4-layer transformer trained from scratch, 10 heads and 32 heads are statistically equivalent on SST-2 and on MRPC (paired TOST over 10 seeds, $\pm1$ point margin), with 69% fewer attention parameters for the 10-head model. Training 10 heads from the start also slightly outperforms training 32 heads and pruning to 10 (0.6 points, $p=0.008$). translated_title: 从内在维度选择注意力头数量：一项小规模研究
translated_abstract: Transformer中注意力头的数量通常由惯例或网格搜索来确定。我们测试了一种简单的启发式方法来预先设置这一数量：在无标签的情况下估计词元表示的内在维度，并使用大致相同数量的注意力头。我们在WikiText-2的DistilBERT嵌入上训练了一个嵌套Dropout变分自编码器（VAE）来估计内在维度，并在VAE率失真曲线的拐点处选择KL权重，而非手动选择。由此得到k*=9.2（95%置信区间[8.6, 9.8]）。在一个从零训练的小型4层transformer中，10个注意力头与32个注意力头在SST-2和MRPC任务上统计等效（10个随机种子的配对TOST检验，±1分容差），而10头模型的注意力参数减少了69%。从一开始就训练10个头也略优于先训练32个头再剪枝到10个头的做法（0.6分，p=0.008）。需要说明的是，证据范围较为有限：仅涉及两个分类任务、一种小型架构、未使用预训练模型。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需标签的启发式方法，通过嵌套Dropout VAE估计词元表示的内在维度来预先确定transformer注意力头的数量，实验表明按内在维度设置约10个注意力头的模型与32个头性能统计等效，且注意力参数减少69%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a label-free heuristic that determines the number of attention heads in a transformer by estimating the intrinsic dimension of token representations with a nested-dropout VAE, showing that a 10-head model is statistically equivalent to a 32-head model while using 69% fewer attention parameters.
